title: Anaheim architect built backyard Disneyland in 1999; 27 years later, it includes 350-LED show
summary_full: For 27 years, David Sheegog has dedicated his Anaheim Hills backyard to crafting a sprawling miniature Disney universe. Initially designed as an educational project for his homeschooling children, this whimsical creation has evolved to include the latest feature, Pixie Hollow, complete with an enchanting water and light show powered by 350 LED lights.
